metadata.development_rationale: Replace the blocked front crosspiece with one usable rear gallery; maintain physical connection between the two linear wings and give the open end an unambiguous public address.
metadata.spatial_thesis: Relocate the low connecting room to the far end so the street-facing mouth opens directly into the court between the two wings.
metadata.ground_repair: Replace the symmetric below-grade bridge macro with a room starting at the same z=0 ground as both wings.
